mechanism_claims.claim_text: VarvA synthetic cyclotide directly permeabilized bacterial membranes in the SYTOX Green assay for E. coli and F. psychrophilum under the reported assay conditions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM evidence showed surface blebbing and partial outer-membrane detachment after MIC-level VarvA exposure in selected fish pathogens.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: VarvA synthetic cyclotide against A. salmonicida, V. ordalii, and F. psychrophilum
mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology supports membrane disruption but does not quantify killing kinetics or distinguish all membrane-disruption models.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper interprets VarvA activity as membrane disruption consistent with cyclotide hydrophobic patches and a detergent-like/carpet-model context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Inferred model context only; final curation does not claim an exact molecular target or pore structure.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Direct support is membrane permeability and SEM morphology; carpet/detergent-like model remains an interpreted mechanism context.
